newsitem.title: USA: Iraq takes bids for 30,000 T U.S. rice - trade.
newsitem.headline: Iraq takes bids for 30,000 T U.S. rice - trade.

text.p: U.S. rice traders and exporters confirmed that Iraq has tendered on Monday for 30,000 tonnes of U.S. long grain white milled rice, broken 10 percent maximum, under that nation's "food-for-oil" program with the United Nations.
Offers are to be opened through February 5.
"There is an actual tender out. So it is a fact," a U.S exporter said. "But whether or not they will buy or not, is another question."
The tender was divided into two 15,000-tonne positions, with one set for April delivery and the other for May delivery, they said.
"A lot of people think Iraq may buy for political reasons," one trader said.
